crossRefs.note: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

translations.web: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
translations.bsb: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?
translations.kjv: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
translations.asv: Though I speak, my grief is not assuaged; And though I forbear, what am I eased?
